name: Web Security Audit
tagline: A defensive security review for sites and repos you own, scored P0 to P2
description: Reviews websites and repositories you control and reports findings ranked by severity, each one backed by the evidence that led to it. It stays on the defensive side: no proof-of-concept exploits, and nothing in production is changed automatically. Every merge waits for you to read the findings and say go.
author: pareshdesai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
